_readme: Text for Tracker's 1cacba9 bugs 1, 3 and 4. No new facts or mechanics.

bug1_gossipPhrases._rule: Match on the fact id's path after runId. Use the line, filling {pride} with the pride name taken from the path. If nothing matches, DROP the gossip beat entirely. Never fall back to the raw id or to fact.summary (summaries are in second person). This applies to both followups.js gossipFact and lone-actions.js speakableFact.
bug1_gossipPhrases.ford_dispute/*: There was trouble at Greywater Ford. A Highcrag cat and a Bonefield cat got into it over a carcass in the water.
bug1_gossipPhrases.player_aided_bonefield: Word is somebody helped a Bonefield cat drag a kill out of the ford, right in front of Highcrag.
bug1_gossipPhrases.ford_choice/help_bonefield_cat: Word is somebody helped a Bonefield cat drag a kill out of the ford, right in front of Highcrag.
bug1_gossipPhrases.player_sided_highcrag: Word is somebody stood with Highcrag at the ford, against Bonefield.
bug1_gossipPhrases.ford_choice/side_with_highcrag: Word is somebody stood with Highcrag at the ford, against Bonefield.
bug1_gossipPhrases.player_stayed_out_ford: I heard somebody at the ford kept out of it and let Highcrag and Bonefield sort it out. I can't decide if that's clever or cowardly.
bug1_gossipPhrases.ford_choice/stay_out: I heard somebody at the ford kept out of it and let Highcrag and Bonefield sort it out. I can't decide if that's clever or cowardly.
bug1_gossipPhrases.hunt_steal/{pride}: Somebody's been stealing from {pride} kills, and {pride} is furious about it.
bug1_gossipPhrases.pride_aid/{pride}: Somebody walked a lost {pride} cub all the way home. {pride} is still talking about it.
bug1_gossipPhrases.scout/{pride}/*: {pride} cats say somebody's been up on the ridges, watching their border.
bug1_gossipPhrases.encounter/encounter.wolf_pack.v1/first_s: The wolves are on the move. Somebody saw a whole pack, and close by.
bug1_gossipPhrases.ford_dispute/*.knows: You were at Greywater Ford when Highcrag and Bonefield squared off over that carcass, weren't you? Everyone's talking about it.
bug1_gossipPhrases.player_aided_bonefield.knows: So it was you who helped Bonefield drag that kill out of the ford, with a Highcrag cat standing right there.
bug1_gossipPhrases.ford_choice/help_bonefield_cat.knows: So it was you who helped Bonefield drag that kill out of the ford, with a Highcrag cat standing right there.
bug1_gossipPhrases.player_sided_highcrag.knows: So you stood with Highcrag at the ford. Word gets around.
bug1_gossipPhrases.ford_choice/side_with_highcrag.knows: So you stood with Highcrag at the ford. Word gets around.
bug1_gossipPhrases.player_stayed_out_ford.knows: I heard you stayed out of that fight at the ford. I'm still not sure what I think about that.
bug1_gossipPhrases.ford_choice/stay_out.knows: I heard you stayed out of that fight at the ford. I'm still not sure what I think about that.
bug1_gossipPhrases.hunt_steal/{pride}.knows: Somebody's been stealing from {pride} kills. Funny thing, the thief they saw looked a lot like you.
bug1_gossipPhrases.pride_aid/{pride}.knows: So it was you who walked that lost {pride} cub home? {pride} still hasn't stopped talking about it.
bug1_gossipPhrases.scout/{pride}/*.knows: Word is you've been up on the ridges, watching the {pride} border.
bug1_gossipPhrases.encounter/encounter.wolf_pack.v1/first_s: So you ran into the wolf pack. Keep well clear of them.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/split_rock.hollow/lie_down: Somebody found a dry hollow behind the Split Rock and had a lie-down in it.
You found that dry hollow behind the Split Rock, didn't you? Was it as snug as it sounds?
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/split_rock.hollow/move_on: Somebody spotted a dry hollow behind the Split Rock and left it be.
You saw that hollow behind the Split Rock and just walked on? I'd have curled up in it.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/greywater_ford.stones/cont: Word is there's a line of dry stones across Greywater Ford, near the far bank.
So it was you who found the dry stones at the ford? Saves a wet paw, that.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/ice_wall.marks/continue: Somebody found old claw marks high up on the Ice Wall, made by a big cat a long time ago.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/ice_wall.marks/continue.kn: You found those old claw marks on the Ice Wall? I'd like to know who made them.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/mere_shore.frog/pounce: Somebody pounced on a frog by the Mere and got nothing but a wet face.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/mere_shore.frog/pounce.kno: I heard a frog got the better of you on the Mere shore. Wet face and all?
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/mere_shore.frog/watch: Somebody sat and watched a frog on the Mere shore until it slipped into the water.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/mere_shore.frog/watch.know: You just sat and watched that frog by the Mere? That's patient of you.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/tar_seeps.bird/continue: A bird got stuck fast in the Tar Seeps. Somebody had the sense to stay back.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/tar_seeps.bird/continue.kn: You saw that bird stuck in the tar, didn't you? Good thing you stayed on firm ground.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/bears_throat.log/continue: A bear's been tearing up rotten logs in the Bear's Throat. Somebody found its fur.
You found bear fur in the Bear's Throat? I'd keep away from there.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/ash_hills.dust/roll: Somebody rolled in the wolves' dust bath in the Ash Hills and came out grey all over.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/ash_hills.dust/roll.knows: Was it you who rolled in that wolf dust bath? I bet you sneezed for ages.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/ash_hills.dust/go_round: There's a wolf dust bath in the Ash Hills. Somebody had the sense to go round it.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/ash_hills.dust/go_round.kn: You went round that wolf dust bath in the Ash Hills? Wise.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/island_mere.goose/continue: There's a goose nesting on a little island in the Mere, hissing at anybody who looks at it.
You left that hissing goose alone? I would have too. That water's cold.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/highcrag.names/continue: Somebody heard the old names being said up by the Highcrag caves.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/highcrag.names/continue.kn: You heard the names being said up at the caves? Not many outsiders get to hear that.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/bonefield.ring/continue: Somebody found a trampled fighting ring out among the bones, with fur caught all round it.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/bonefield.ring/continue.kn: You found that fighting ring in the Bonefield? Somebody's been settling things out there.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/mistwood.den/continue: Somebody found an old empty den in the Mistwood. Nobody's lived in it for a long time.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/mistwood.den/continue.know: You found that empty den in the Mistwood? Whoever lived there left in a hurry.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/south_range.herd/continue: A big herd crossed the South Range, kicking up dust all along the far edge.
You saw that herd cross the South Range? I heard the dust hung there for ages.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/wind_scree/continue: Somebody flushed a hare on the Wind Scree, much too far down to chase.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/wind_scree/continue.knows: That hare on the scree got away from you? It was too far down anyway.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/north_pass/continue: Somebody climbed up North Pass and looked out over the whole Vale.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/north_pass/continue.knows: You went all the way up North Pass just to look? I'd like to see that view.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/tallgrass/continue: A grouse burst out of Tallgrass Reach right under somebody's nose.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/tallgrass/continue.knows: I heard a grouse nearly flew into your face in the tall grass. Did you jump?
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/south_range/continue: Somebody spent a while staring at a shape on the South Range. It was only a horse.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/south_range/continue.knows: You stared at that shape on the range until it turned out to be a horse? I've done that.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/reedbank/continue: Somebody finally spotted the little brown bird that throws its voice in the Reedbank.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/reedbank/continue.knows: You actually spotted the bird in the reeds? I've never managed it.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/east_saddle/continue: Somebody heard stones falling on East Saddle. Nothing came of it.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/east_saddle/continue.knows: You heard the stones coming down on East Saddle? Nothing came after them, at least.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/wolf_run/continue: Somebody waited a long while on Wolf Run and left before any wolves turned up.
bug1_gossipPhrases.region_moment/wolf_run/continue.knows: You hung about on Wolf Run? You were lucky no wolves turned up.
bug1_gossipPhrases.standing_deed/highcrag/drive_hyena/fact: Somebody helped a Highcrag hunter drive a hyena off a kill.
I heard you helped drive that hyena off the Highcrag kill. That took nerve.
bug1_gossipPhrases.standing_deed/highcrag/share_kill/fact: Somebody stayed and guarded a Highcrag kill after the hyena was gone.
bug1_gossipPhrases.standing_deed/highcrag/share_kill/fact.k: You stayed and guarded that meat for Highcrag? That was decent of you.
bug1_gossipPhrases.standing_deed/highcrag/return_trespasser: Somebody asked a cat to move off the Highcrag cache, and the cat went.
I heard you got that cat to move off the Highcrag cache. How did you manage it?
bug1_gossipPhrases.standing_deed/highcrag/steal_kill/fact: Somebody took meat from a Highcrag kill, right in front of the hunter.
bug1_gossipPhrases.standing_deed/highcrag/steal_kill/fact.k: I heard you took from a Highcrag kill. The hunter saw you, you know.
bug1_gossipPhrases.player_left_hyena: A hyena backed off a Highcrag kill, and somebody just walked away after.
bug1_gossipPhrases.player_left_hyena.knows: That hyena by the Highcrag kill backed off, and you just left? Fair enough.
bug1_gossipPhrases.hunted_at_meadows: Somebody went after a foal out on Horse Meadows.
bug1_gossipPhrases.hunted_at_meadows.knows: I heard you went after a foal on the meadows. Brave, or just hungry?
bug1_gossipPhrases.watched_meadows: Somebody sat and watched the horse herd on Horse Meadows for a while.
bug1_gossipPhrases.watched_meadows.knows: You watched the herd on the meadows? They're something to see, aren't they?
bug1_gossipPhrases.spar/*: Word is somebody's been sparring with the cats round here.
bug1_gossipPhrases.spar/*.knows: I heard you had a spar. How did it go?
bug1_gossipPhrases.shadow/*: Somebody's been trailing cats to see where they go.
bug1_gossipPhrases.shadow/*.knows: I hear you've been following cats about. Find out anything?

bug3_scoutStanding._rule: Replaces lone-actions.js:584 `${name}'s standing toward you is ${standing}.` Pick by standing, using the same thresholds as the code. The number can go on the result line if Tundra wants it shown.
bug3_scoutStanding.high_ge_15: The {pride} cats on the border hardly bristle at your scent. You're not a stranger to them now.
bug3_scoutStanding.middle: The {pride} cats on the border don't seem sure what to make of you yet.
bug3_scoutStanding.low_le_minus_15: Any {pride} cat on that border would chase you off on sight.

bug4_slice.meeting.loner._rule: Replace the single sociability-baseline speech beat with these five. Middle sociability with high or low boldness gets its own line. Middle sociability with middle boldness then splits by aggression, so exactly one greeting plays.

beats.text: "Just you, then." {catName} looks you over, unhurried, from ears to bobtail. "Good. I don't like being outnumbered on my own trail."
"Are you…" {catName} swallows and tries again, quieter. "Are you on your own? I don't want any trouble."
"Just you?" {catName}'s tail lashes once. "Then you've got no one to blame if you put a paw wrong out here."
"Just you?" {catName} glances past you at the empty trail. "Or is someone following you?"
"Just you? Me too." {catName}'s shoulders ease a little. "There's room on this trail for two, if neither of us makes a fuss."

bug4_curiosity_tail.text: Where did you come from, anyway? Nobody just turns up out here.
bug4_curiosity_tail._note: Optional last beat, after the greeting. It plays for any loner with curiosity >= 70.

regionCallbacks.region_moment/split_rock.hollow/lie_down: The dry hollow behind the Split Rock is where you lay down last time. It still looks snug.
regionCallbacks.region_moment/split_rock.hollow/move_on: You pass the dry hollow behind the Split Rock again. You walked on last time too.
regionCallbacks.region_moment/greywater_ford.stones/cont: You know where the dry stones are at this ford now. Your paws find them without looking.
regionCallbacks.region_moment/ice_wall.marks/continue: You look up for the old claw marks on the Ice Wall. They're still there, high above you.
regionCallbacks.region_moment/mere_shore.frog/pounce: This is the shore where a frog left you with a wet face. You watch your step.
regionCallbacks.region_moment/mere_shore.frog/watch: This is the shore where you sat and watched a frog slip into the water.
regionCallbacks.region_moment/tar_seeps.bird/continue: You remember the bird stuck in the tar here. You keep to firm ground.
regionCallbacks.region_moment/bears_throat.log/continue: You pass the log the bear tore up. The fur on it is old now.
regionCallbacks.region_moment/ash_hills.dust/roll: You pass the wolf dust bath where you came up grey and sneezing. Your nose twitches at the memory.
regionCallbacks.region_moment/ash_hills.dust/go_round: You pass the wolf dust bath again and go round it, same as before.
regionCallbacks.region_moment/island_mere.goose/continue: You glance at the little island where the goose was nesting. You leave it alone again.
regionCallbacks.region_moment/highcrag.names/continue: Near the caves, you think of the old voice you heard saying names here.
regionCallbacks.region_moment/bonefield.ring/continue: You pass the trampled ring where cats fought. The ground is still scuffed.
regionCallbacks.region_moment/mistwood.den/continue: You pass the empty den in the Mistwood. It still stands empty.
regionCallbacks.region_moment/south_range.herd/continue: You look out over the South Range, where you watched the herd go by.
regionCallbacks.region_moment/wind_scree/continue: You look down the scree to where the hare broke cover, too far below to chase.
regionCallbacks.region_moment/north_pass/continue: From North Pass, you follow the river with your eyes again.
regionCallbacks.region_moment/tallgrass/continue: You tread carefully through the tall grass. You haven't forgotten that grouse.
regionCallbacks.region_moment/south_range/continue: You spot a shape on the range and wonder if it's a horse again.
regionCallbacks.region_moment/reedbank/continue: You listen for the small brown bird in the reeds. You know what it looks like now.
regionCallbacks.region_moment/east_saddle/continue: You remember the stone that clattered down here. Nothing followed it then either.
regionCallbacks.region_moment/wolf_run/continue: You're back on Wolf Run. Last time no wolves came. You don't plan to wait and see.

mateRegionLines.region_moment/split_rock.hollow/lie_down: You told me about that dry hollow behind the Split Rock. Was it really that snug?
mateRegionLines.region_moment/split_rock.hollow/move_on: That hollow behind the Split Rock you told me about. Why didn't you lie down in it?
mateRegionLines.region_moment/greywater_ford.stones/cont: Those dry stones you found at the ford. I tried them. They held.
mateRegionLines.region_moment/ice_wall.marks/continue: I keep thinking about those claw marks you saw on the Ice Wall. How big was that cat?
mateRegionLines.region_moment/mere_shore.frog/pounce: So a frog got the better of you at the Mere? Wet face and all, I heard.
mateRegionLines.region_moment/mere_shore.frog/watch: You just watched that frog swim off? You're more patient than me.
mateRegionLines.region_moment/tar_seeps.bird/continue: That bird you saw in the tar. I'm glad you stayed back.
mateRegionLines.region_moment/bears_throat.log/continue: You said there's a bear about in the Bear's Throat. Be careful up there, will you?
mateRegionLines.region_moment/ash_hills.dust/roll: You still smell a bit like wolf, you know. From that dust bath.
mateRegionLines.region_moment/ash_hills.dust/go_round: Good thing you went round that wolf dust bath. I'd have made you sleep outside.
mateRegionLines.region_moment/island_mere.goose/continue: That goose on the island. Leave it be. Geese bite.
mateRegionLines.region_moment/highcrag.names/continue: You heard them saying names up at the Highcrag caves? What were they like?
mateRegionLines.region_moment/bonefield.ring/continue: That fighting ring you found. Any idea who it was?
mateRegionLines.region_moment/mistwood.den/continue: That empty den in the Mistwood. I wonder why they left in such a hurry.
mateRegionLines.region_moment/south_range.herd/continue: You told me about the herd on the South Range. I'd have liked to see it.
mateRegionLines.region_moment/wind_scree/continue: Still sore about that hare on the scree? It was too far anyway.
mateRegionLines.region_moment/north_pass/continue: You went up North Pass just to look at the river? Take me next time.
mateRegionLines.region_moment/tallgrass/continue: A grouse got you in the tall grass, I hear. Did you jump very high?
mateRegionLines.region_moment/south_range/continue: So the shape on the range was just a horse. I'd have stared too.
mateRegionLines.region_moment/reedbank/continue: You actually saw that little brown bird in the reeds? Lucky you.
mateRegionLines.region_moment/east_saddle/continue: Those falling stones on East Saddle. Nothing came after them? Good.
mateRegionLines.region_moment/wolf_run/continue: You waited on Wolf Run? Don't do that again, all right?
